zw.pickCity: Please choose a municipality above – the workbench checks one operator's zones in one municipality.
zw.noZones: No operator publishes zones (geofencing_zones) for {name}. The workbench only checks zones from open feeds; your own zones stay with you. Municipalities with zones:
zw.title: Zones of {op} in {name}
zw.sub: {n} zones from {files} zone feed(s) of the operator (GBFS geofencing_zones), clipped to the municipality.
zw.ownSpots: Own spots CSV (stays in the browser)
zw.mapLabel: Map of the zones with the findings
zw.exportSub: One file per category: same type merged, holes cut open with a 1 cm gap, outer ring counter-clockwise, only fields on the allow list. Checked like the upload before download.
zw.historySub: Changes to this operator's zone feeds, detected on every collector run (zones-log.json).
zw.status: Checked with {spots} spots ({own} of them from your own CSV); OSM reasons: {osm}.
zw.answer: {op} has {n} zones in {name}: {ov} overlaps of the same type, {gaps} gaps or pockets and {spots} spots in a restricted zone.
zw.kpiOverlapsCmp: zones of the same type stacked by more than 1 m²
zw.how: Overlap: intersection of two zones of the same type from 1 m². Gap: two zones of the same type come closer than 3 m without touching. Pocket: an enclosed area under 2,500 m² that no other zone fills. Spot in a restriction: station or spot inside a no-parking or no-riding zone without a smaller allowed zone at the place. Restriction without an OSM reason: no water, track, cemetery, school grounds, square, stop or similar inside the zone or within 30 m.
zw.noFindings: No findings. The zones are reloaded with every collector run (about every 18 minutes).
zw.noHistory: No changes since recording began; checked on every collector run (about every 18 minutes).
zw.exNote: Source are the public zone feeds; the file is created here in the browser. Areas above 50 km² (inverse of the operating area) and the operating area itself belong in the geofence and are left out. The backend sets parentSubregionId when inserting into the region.
zw.osmLoading: Querying OSM reasons via Overpass (up to two minutes) …
zw.osmFail: Overpass not reachable – please try again later.
zw.answerNone: There are no zones from open feeds for {name} – nothing to check.
